BRAND GUIDELINES
CHARM

Food, luck & prosperity — a fortune-telling menu in collaboration with Sala Thai.

FOOD LUCK   PROSPERITY   CHARM® IN COLLABORATION WITH SALA THAI
01 — THE IDEA

A little extra luck
to a good meal.

Food, luck, and prosperity are things we gather around, wish for, and share with one another. Charm brings the three together through a playful digital experience inspired by Thai fortune telling.

Guests tap or scan the menu to draw a fortune — revealing playful predictions about love, health, wealth, and work.

DRAW YOUR FORTUNE
02 — THE NAME
Charm sounds like /ชาม/
— a dish or bowl in Thai.

Ambiguously, Charm is also part of a lucky charm in English. Some fortunes take inspiration from Sala Thai's signature dishes — weaving the food and its character into the readings themselves.

CHARM®ILLUSTRATION
08 — ART DIRECTION

Heritage silver,
painterly warmth.

Two registers of imagery. Cool, engraved silverware — “Hôtel Premeno” — signals occasion and heritage. Warm, loose oil painting brings food, table and appetite. Together they hold the tension in the name.
